tools.name: calculate_raw_weight_to_buy

tools.description: Look up the USDA cooking yield percent for a cut of meat or poultry and a cooking method, with the yield range, sample count, moisture change and fat change measured by USDA, plus up to 4 close alternative rows with their yield_id.
